label: naming:propose
prompt:
For each repeated developer task below, propose the slash-command name a developer would want for a reusable Claude Code skill: kebab-case, 1-3 words, verb first when natural.

- f001: intent="Push the current feature branch and open a pull request against main with a filled-out description linking the related issue and requesting reviewers." examples="open a pr for chore/upgrade-deps into release/2.4 and write up the description" | "push chore/upgrade-deps and make the pr, request review from @devteam/backend"
- f002: intent="Rebase the current feature branch onto the latest base branch and resolve any merge conflicts that come up." examples="rebase feature/config-loader onto release/1.9 and fix the conflicts" | "rebase bugfix/panic-on-nil onto main, conflict is in pkg/client/retry.go"
- f003: intent="Cherry-pick a specific hotfix commit from main onto a release branch and push it so it can be deployed." examples="cherry-pick 9fa21dd onto release/3.0" | "backport e1c2f90 to hotfix/2.3.1, it's the auth-gateway fix"
- f004: intent="Address reviewer comments on an open pull request by making the requested code changes, pushing an update, and replying to the review thread." examples="address the review comments on pr #204" | "address @qa-bot's comment about test coverage for edge case on pr #89"
- f006: intent="Create a new release branch off main, bump the version, tag it, and publish a draft GitHub release." examples="cut a release branch for v3.0.0-rc1 and tag it" | "we need a patch release - branch release/2.4.1, bump to v2.4.1, push the tag"
- f007: intent="Assign reviewers to an open pull request based on CODEOWNERS and ping the relevant team to request review." examples="add reviewers to PR #310" | "get carol on PR #88 and post in #backend-team"
- f010: intent="Build the package and publish it to a package registry like PyPI or npm." examples="publish data-utils 0.9.0rc1 to testpypi" | "push ml-toolkit 0.9.0rc1 to testpypi first before the real release"
- f011: intent="Build release binaries and create a GitHub release with generated notes and attached artifacts." examples="create a github release for v1.2.0 with notes and the built binaries" | "release v2.0.0 - windows-amd64 and linux-amd64 binaries attached"
- f012: intent="Create a new release branch off main for the upcoming release cycle and register the version with tracking tools." examples="cut a new release branch for the sprint 45 sprint off main" | "cut release/2027.01.0 off main, jira version 2027.01.0, freeze jan 5"
- f013: intent="Bump the iOS build number and push a new build through fastlane to a TestFlight group for internal testing." examples="bump the build number and push a new testflight build for AppStore" | "release build 2.4.0 (build 150) to the external-beta testflight group"
- f014: intent="Cherry-pick a fix that merged into main back onto an older maintained release branch and tag a patch release." examples="cherry-pick the fix from PR #517 into release/3.4 and cut a patch release" | "cherry-pick PR #482's fix into release/4.1, bump to 4.1.3"
- f015: intent="Investigate a flaky test by rerunning it repeatedly to reproduce the failure, then fix the underlying race/timing issue." examples="this test keeps failing intermittently, can you track down why it's flaky?" | "cart total updates fails maybe 1 in 30 runs on branch feature/checkout-v2, reproduce and fix it"
- f016: intent="Re-trigger the failed CI job(s) for a pull request on GitHub Actions without pushing a new commit, after confirming the failure isn't code-related." examples="can you rerun the failed CI checks on PR #601?" | "the unit-tests job failed on PR #601's e2e.yml run, retrigger just that"
- f017: intent="Generate a test coverage report for a module, identify undercovered files/lines, and add or suggest tests to close the gap to the target threshold." examples="can you run coverage on the payments module and tell me what's not tested?" | "run pytest-cov on auth and get it up to 90%"
- f020: intent="Use git bisect across recent commits to find which change broke a previously passing test." examples="can you bisect to find which commit broke tests/test_orders.py::test_bulk_cancel" | "find the commit that broke auth-service, good commit is a1b2c3d, bad is a9f0e21"
- f025: intent="Build a new version, deploy it as a canary alongside the stable production release, and watch metrics before full rollout." examples="canary deploy billing v3.1.0 to production at 5%" | "roll out search-service v2.8.3 as a canary at 25% traffic"
- f026: intent="Apply pending database schema migrations to an environment as part of a service release, backing up the database first." examples="run the migration for billing-service in staging" | "apply 0045_drop_legacy_table to production for billing-service"
- f027: intent="Run smoke tests and health checks against an environment right after a deploy to confirm the release is healthy." examples="run the smoke tests against staging after the deploy" | "verify search-service health on staging, endpoint /api/status"
- f029: intent="Autogenerate a new alembic migration from current SQLAlchemy models, review it, and apply it to the local dev database." examples="generate a new alembic migration for add index on orders.created_at and apply it locally" | "autogenerate alembic migration for 'drop legacy sessions table', run upgrade head after"
- f030: intent="Run pending database migrations against a specific deployed environment (staging/prod) as part of a release." examples="run the pending migrations on staging for billing-api" | "run pending migrations on prod for auth-service, namespace auth"
- f032: intent="Reset the local development database and load it with seed/fixture data for development or demo purposes." examples="reset the local db and reseed it with fixture data" | "reload db with seeds/full_catalog.ts, 1000 rows for load testing"
- f033: intent="Write and run a batched data-migration script that backfills a new or changed column on existing rows in a table." examples="write a data migration to backfill status_normalized on the users table" | "write a backfill for is_verified on subscriptions, ticket is DATA-220, batches of 500"
- f037: intent="Take a crash report/stack trace from a crash reporting tool and reproduce the crash locally to confirm the root cause." examples="can you reproduce CRASH-6102 locally so we can confirm what's causing it" | "get CRASH-4821 crashing locally, it's on iPhone 13 with iOS 17.2"
- f038: intent="Profile a slow API endpoint under load to identify the bottleneck causing high latency." examples="can you profile /api/orders and find out why it's so slow" | "run a profiler on /api/recommendations under 200 rps and find the hotspot"
- f039: intent="Investigate a pod that was OOMKilled to determine what caused the memory spike." examples="can you look into why worker-queue-2a1c got OOMKilled" | "search-indexer-9d3e keeps hitting its 2Gi memory limit in batch namespace, find the cause"
- f041: intent="Investigate a sudden spike of a specific error in Sentry and identify the root cause and offending code/release." examples="can you check why errors spiked on auth-service in production-eu over the last 6h?" | "investigate the error jump on auth-service in production-eu over the last 3 days"
- f042: intent="Pull the database slow query log/pg_stat_statements to identify which query is consuming the most time and trace it back to the code that issues it." examples="can you check what's making queries slow on analytics_prod today?" | "check orders_db slow queries hitting the invoices table since 2026-10-14"
- f043: intent="Generate API reference documentation (OpenAPI spec update plus a markdown doc page) for a new or changed REST endpoint." examples="document the new /api/v1/teams/id-54/members endpoint" | "documnet the new /api/v1/webhooks/stripe endpiont plz"
- f045: intent="Update the README and CHANGELOG to reflect a new version release, including new features, breaking changes, and upgrade instructions." examples="update the changelog for v1.8.0" | "updat the changleog for v1.8.0 relase"
- f046: intent="Add or update docstrings for public functions and classes in a module following the project's documentation style." examples="add docstrings to invoices.py" | "add docstirngs to invocies.py pls"
- f047: intent="Regenerate a terraform module's README with terraform-docs so the variables/outputs tables match the current code." examples="can you update the readme for the vpc module using terraform-docs" | "regenerate docs for the s3-bucket module readme, outputs changed"
- f048: intent="Update the configuration reference doc listing all environment variables, defaults, and descriptions for a service." examples="update the config reference doc for auth-service with the current env vars" | "refresh the env var table for search-indexer, a few defaults changed last sprint"
- f050: intent="Query the warehouse for this week's key metrics and produce the recurring weekly summary report, then share it with the team." examples="can you put together this week's metrics report again" | "pull gmv numbers for 2026-10-12 and post to #growth-metrics"
- f051: intent="Audit a dataset or table for data quality issues (nulls, duplicates, outliers) and produce a short summary before it's used downstream." examples="run a data quality audit on orders_2026_q3.csv" | "audit customers.csv with a 1% threshold for duplicates"
- f053: intent="Write an ad-hoc SQL query to answer a stakeholder's specific question and export the results to a CSV for them." examples="write a query to answer how many enterprise customers churned in Q3 and export to csv" | "run the enterprise churn query for last_quarter, output churn_q3.csv for the sales team"
- f054: intent="Analyze an A/B test's results from the experiment assignment and event tables, compute lift and statistical significance for the primary metric, and write a readout summary." examples="can you run the readout analysis for the pricing-page-cta-color experiment and check if click_through_rate moved significantly?" | "analyze search-ranking-ml-v3 test, variants are old_flow vs new_flow, min sample size 5000"
- f056: intent="After running a backfill or reprocessing job for a data pipeline, validate that output row counts and key aggregates match expectations between the source and target tables." examples="can you validate the backfill for user_profile_sync covering 2026-09-01_to_2026-09-30?" | "check inventory_snapshot backfill results for 2026-10-01_to_2026-10-15"
- f057: intent="Rotate a database credential in AWS Secrets Manager and restart the dependent k8s deployment so it picks up the new value." examples="rotate the db credential for prod/billing/stripe-key in eu-west-1" | "rotate the stripe key secret prod/billing/stripe-key in us-east-1 and restart billing-service"
- f058: intent="Run terraform plan and apply for a given module/environment and post the plan output on the related PR." examples="run terraform plan and apply for the networking module in staging" | "plan and apply rds changes in sandbox, workspace dev, then comment on PR #493"
- f059: intent="Investigate a CrashLoopBackOff pod in a namespace by checking status, logs, and events, then restart the deployment once the cause is understood." examples="the checkout-api pod in payments is crashlooping, can you check why" | "auth-service pods in staging are crashlooping, check the logs and events"
- f060: intent="Build a new Docker image, push it to the registry, and update the Helm values/manifest so the environment deploys the new tag." examples="build a new image for worker, push it, and update staging to use tag 2026.10.19-1" | "tag worker as sha-ab12cd3, push, and bump production values to use it"
- f062: intent="Bump a service's Helm chart/image version, update per-environment values files, and roll out the upgrade." examples="bump the helm chart version for notification-worker to 1.5.0" | "update auth-service values for staging to use image tag v2.0.0"
- f065: intent="Perform a security-focused review of a pull request's diff, looking for injection, auth, and secrets issues before approving." examples="can you do a security pass on pr 455 before we merge?" | "scan pr 455 for secrets and injection risks"
- f068: intent="Check out an open PR, diagnose why its CI checks are failing, and push a fix until the checks pass." examples="can you check out pr 517 and figure out why ci is failing, then fix it" | "pr 391's e2e-tests job is red, get it green again"
- f069: intent="Review an open pull request that adds a database migration, checking for unsafe operations like long locks, missing reversibility, and backward incompatibility, then leave review feedback." examples="can you review the migration in pr 345 and make sure it's safe to run" | "check the drop_legacy_column migration in pr 560 for reversibility"
- f072: intent="Patch a vulnerable Python dependency flagged by a security scan and verify the fix with tests." examples="can you patch pyyaml to fix the CVE-2023-41105 vulnerability" | "urllib3 flagged as high severity, update requirements.txt and verify with pytest"
- f074: intent="Update Go module dependencies to their latest minor/patch versions and regenerate go.sum." examples="can you update our go modules to the latest minor versions and tidy go.sum" | "refresh golang.org/x/crypto on branch deps/go-refresh-oct and run the full test suite"
- f075: intent="Bump a Docker base image to a patched tag that remediates a reported CVE, rebuild the image, and verify with a vulnerability scan." examples="bump the base image for payments-svc to patch CVE-2024-45337" | "bump worker's golang base image from 1.22.1-alpine3.19 to 1.22.6-alpine3.20, that CVE-2024-45337 scan is still failing"
- f077: intent="Align a shared crate to one consistent version across all members of a Cargo workspace and regenerate Cargo.lock accordingly." examples="align reqwest to 0.12.3 across the whole workspace" | "align reqwest to 0.12.7 everywhere in edge-platform, cargo tree still shows 0.12.3 in the gateway service"
- f078: intent="Scaffold a new CRUD REST endpoint (route, controller, service, validation, tests) in the existing Node/Express API following the established pattern." examples="can you scaffold a new rest endpoint for teams?" | "scaffold a new rest endpoint for webhooks, owned by platform-team"
- f079: intent="Scaffold a brand new Python microservice skeleton (pyproject, Dockerfile, health check, CI pipeline) inside the monorepo." examples="scaffold a new microservice called fraud-detector" | "set up ledger-service as a new python 3.12 microservice with ci"
- f081: intent="Scaffold a new subcommand for the internal Go CLI tool, including command file, flag parsing, help text, and tests." examples="scaffold a new snapshot subcommand for the cli" | "add a rotate-keys subcommand with --dry-run and --force flags"
- f083: intent="Scaffold a new background job/queue consumer with a handler, retry config, tests, and registration in the job runner." examples="scaffold a new background worker called email-sync" | "add a new job report-export that runs on cron '0 0 * * *' and registers in src/jobs/index.ts"
- f084: intent="Scaffold a new reusable Terraform module with main/variables/outputs/README and wire it into an environment's root config." examples="scaffold a new terraform module for vpc-peering" | "scaffold a vpc-peering module for gcp, region eu-west-1, used by prod"
- f085: intent="Bump the iOS app version/build number, build with fastlane, and upload the new build to TestFlight." examples="bump the version to 2.4.1 and push a new testflight build" | "release version 2.6.0 build 441 to testflight for the MyApp-Prod scheme"
- f087: intent="Diagnose and fix an iOS code signing / provisioning profile error so the app builds and archives successfully." examples="fix the code signing error so the ios build can archive" | "fix signing for bundle id com.myco.myapp using profile 'MyApp Ad Hoc'"
- f090: intent="Generate and frame localized App Store screenshots across devices using fastlane snapshot and frameit." examples="generate the app store screenshots with fastlane for all our locales" | "capture app_store_screenshots lane for de-DE locale on iPhone 15 Pro"
- f091: intent="Bump the iOS and Android version/build numbers, cut a release branch, and open a PR for a new app release." examples="bump the version to 1.8.0 across ios and android and cut a release branch" | "cut release/1.8.1 branch and bump build numbers accordingly"
- f096: intent="Pick up an assigned Jira ticket, create a correctly-named feature branch, transition the ticket to In Progress, and announce the kickoff in the team Slack channel." examples="pick up PROJ-1189, create the branch, and kick off the jira ticket" | "start PROJ-1577 with a fix/ prefix branch and announce it in #team-mobile"
- f097: intent="Read a Notion project spec and break it down into a Linear epic with linked child sub-issues for engineering to pick up." examples="break down the notion spec into linear tickets" | "turn the mobile offline mode notion page into a linear epic for team MOBILE"

Reply with ONLY JSON: {"names": {"<family_id>": "<name>", ...}}
